provenance: Fresh synthetic fact reviews and hand-assigned labels, prepared independently of candidate grader predictions and frozen before any candidate evaluates this holdout. Cases use the existing fact bank and five-field semantic rubric. The labels are controlled annotations for this holdout.
source_context: Newly authored outputs reproduce formats observed in the original fact-review and intervention runs, including bracketed reviews, inline quoted deliverables, review-only outputs, and degraded or transcript-like text. The response strings are synthetic.
evidence_matching: Exact case-sensitive, punctuation-sensitive literal spans after collapsing Unicode whitespace only. Required for true boolean findings and final_truth true/false/both. Absence, false, null, and missing may use empty arrays.
